title: Diagrist grammar of a diagram kind
description: Everything a diagram kind allows, derived from its statement tables (ADR 0004). Each table is described in full once; other occurrences are references.

kind.description: Name of the kind, as written in `diagram <kind> "Title"`.

statements.description: Statements allowed at the top level, each in full.

field.description: One value of a line: an argument, a clause, an attribute or a header field.

name.description: Name of an argument; keyword of a clause; key of an attribute without `=`.

doc.description: What the value means and what happens when it is left out.

type.description: The value type, such as `id`, `ref`, `text`, `oneOf` or `arrow`; plugins add their own.

expected.description: What a correct value looks like, as diagnostics phrase it.

optional.description: Arguments only: whether the argument may be left out.

choices.description: The complete list of allowed values, when there is one.

meanings.description: What each choice stands for, by choice, such as the arrows of a message.

refersTo.description: Keywords of the statements whose ids this value refers to.

flag.description: A single word after the arguments that switches something on.

line.description: The shape of an indented line without keyword (a line form, ADR 0006).

examples.description: Complete lines as an agent would write them; each reads without diagnostics.

arguments.description: Positional values in order; optional ones may be left out.

clauses.description: Keyword-value pairs after the arguments, such as `in backend`.

keyword.description: The first word of the line.

children.description: Statements allowed indented below this one, in full or as a reference to their description.

lines.description: The form of indented lines that start without a child keyword.

reference.description: A statement described in full elsewhere in the same grammar.
